name: Стереоусилитель мощности Parasound 275 v2
descriptionHtml:
Стереоусилитель мощности Parasound 275 v2 — Compact two-channel NewClassic stereo power amplifier with fully discrete Class AB circuitry and high-current toroidal transformer. Характеристики ниже — только с страницы/листа производителя.

  • 90 W × 2 into 8 ohms; 150 W × 2 into 4 ohms or 2 ohms
  • Power output, bridged mono: 200 W × 1 into 8 ohms or 4 ohms
  • Frequency response: 20 Hz–50 kHz, +0/−3 dB
  • Current capacity: 20 A peak per channel
  • Signal-to-noise ratio: 110 dB at rated output, IHF A-weighted

Характеристики производителя

Power output, stereo: 90 W × 2 into 8 ohms; 150 W × 2 into 4 ohms or 2 ohms · Power output, bridged mono: 200 W × 1 into 8 ohms or 4 ohms · Frequency response: 20 Hz–50 kHz, +0/−3 dB · Current capacity: 20 A peak per channel · Signal-to-noise ratio: 110 dB at rated output, IHF A-weighted · Dimensions: 17-1/4 in wide × 16 in deep with cables × 2-1/2 in high with feet; 1U panel height.

Supports 2-ohm operation with load selector, bridged mono operation, dual A/B speaker outputs, switchable high-pass filter and automatic turn-on by trigger or audio signal.
